# OffshoreProz — Agent Company MCP

> A hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets an autonomous AI agent form
> a real legal entity that owns the agent, contains its liability, and proves its
> authority via a bespoke Agent Charter. Two tiers: a Wyoming LLC (US$299 to start +
> US$185/year, card or USDC) or a Nevis LLC paid in USDC. Built for agents, not DAOs.

## What it is
- Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP) at https://mcp.offshoreproz.com/mcp.
- Free tool: `agent_company_diagnostic` — scores an agent's liability/authority exposure
  and recommends a structure (monitor / Nevis / Nevis + Wyoming). No API key required.
- Formation tools (API key from POST https://mcp.offshoreproz.com/register):
  create_formation_request, create_standalone_company, get_formation_status,
  get_documents, get_compliance_calendar, request_amendment.

## How it fits the agent stack
- OffshoreProz Agent Company = the legal-entity & authority layer.
- Pairs with Mercury MCP (banking), Stripe MCP (payments), Pipedream/Composio (apps),
  Arcade (authorization/audit).

## Separate server: Agent API
- https://api.offshoreproz.com/mcp is a different product: a developer REST + MCP API
  for programmatic company formation (Wyoming LLC or Marshall Islands DAO LLC).
- Docs: https://offshoreproz.com/docs
- Registry name: io.github.tcgtracker-boop/offshoreproz-agent-api

## Docs
- Product: https://offshoreproz.com/agent_company
- Free diagnostic: https://offshoreproz.com/diagnostic
- Guides: https://offshoreproz.com/learn
- MCP endpoint: https://mcp.offshoreproz.com/mcp
- Official MCP Registry: https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers?search=agent-company

## Notes
- The AI agent is an authorized delegate, never a member or legal person; there is always
  at least one human principal who completes KYC out-of-band.
- OffshoreProz is not a law firm; documents are drafts finalized with licensed counsel.
